title: 替人挨罚

shots.new_info: 萨拉在机位前哭，面前一叠没做完的校服；索菲娅在过道看着

Locked-off camera, faint handheld breath. Cold overhead fluorescent from above, warm yellow machine lights from below. Cinematic realistic vertical 9:16.
